Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Bharat Kumar Dixit, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri S.N. Goswami, learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Shivmurti alias Shiva seeks bail in Case Crime No. 360 of 2021, under sections 363, 366, 376 (3), I.P.C., and section 7/8, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, P.S. Gurubaksh Ganj, District Raebareli.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.I.R.) lodged on 19th of August 2021, stating that in the night of 15th of August 2021, the applicant had enticed away the informant's minor daughter.
4.

In her statement recorded under section 161, CrPC the alleged victim/informant's daughter stated that she used to talk to the applicant for the past one month and the applicant had taken her to the house of his sister and he did not commit any misdeed with her.
The victim declined to undergo medico-legal examination.
In her statement recorded under section 164 CrPC.
she again stated that she used to talk to the applicant for the past one month, but a quarrel took place between them.

5. Statement of some independent witnesses were also recorded by the investigating officer, who also stated that there was a love-affair between the applicant and the victim.
6. A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant annexing therewith the statement of the informant and the victim recorded by the trial court.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that there are several discrepancies in the statement of the informant and the victim recorded at various stages.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that prima facie it appears from the statement of the victim, as also from the statement of some independent persons, recorded by the investigating officer, that there are some kind of relations between the victim and the applicant; that the victim has declined to undergo medico legal examination; that the statements of the informant and the victim have already been recorded by the trial court and the applicant is not in a position to influence the investigation, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 4th of October 2020,
without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
